name: Nova Lite
description: Fast, low-cost multimodal model for high-volume workloads.
longDescription: Amazon Nova Lite is a very low-cost multimodal model that processes text, images, and video inputs. It is designed for high-speed, high-volume tasks where cost efficiency is paramount while still maintaining competitive quality.

codeSnippets.label: Python
codeSnippets.code:
import boto3
import json

client = boto3.client("bedrock-runtime")
response = client.invoke_model(
    modelId="amazon.nova-lite-v1:0",
    body=json.dumps({"messages": [{"role": "user", "content": [{"text": "Hello!"}]}]})
)
result = json.loads(response["body"].read())
print(result["output"]["message"]["content"][0]["text"])
